parsed.name: VISA串口通信组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过VISA串口会话与实验仪器进行通用消息通信。它提供会话初始化、关闭、连接状态检查以及原始字节收发功能，通常作为具体仪器驱动的基础层使用，而不是某一台特定硬件仪器本身。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component for generic message-based communication with laboratory instruments over a VISA serial session. It provides session initialization, shutdown, connection-state checking, and raw byte send/receive functions, typically serving as a base layer for specific instrument drivers rather than representing a particular hardware instrument itself.
